stage2_physics_modules.kim_levels: KIM-L 925/850 hPa T,RH,U,V for the Jeju box aggregated to 204 DFS points, issue 2026-10-16 18 UTC, lead 0-9 h

modules.dew_point: Magnus at the 5 km point, 2 degC/km dew-point lapse to the cell, capped at the cell temperature
modules.lcl: point elevation + 125 m per degC (T - Td); in-cloud when the cell is at or above it
modules.cross_barrier_wind: KIM 850 hPa wind, fallback 10 m forecast wind
modules.foehn: upstream forecast point in the wind direction at up_dist; dry ascent to LCL, saturated ascent (local moist lapse, 50 m steps) to the upstream ridge up_max, dry descent to the cell; index = foehn T - lapse T; active = condensation + lee depth >= 300 m + wind >= 5 m/s + index >= 1 degC

stage2_physics_modules.browser_check: local build: 3 new colour metrics (cell_td, lcl_rel, foehn) and 2 highlight layers render, foehn cells on the lee (west/north-west) side of the ESE 850 hPa wind, fog cells around the summit; console errors 0
stage2_physics_modules.finding: dew point remains the weak variable (RMSE 4.3 degC vs AWS): the 5 km humidity at the high stations is biased moist in the morning; the foehn parcel does not fix this because most high stations sit on the windward side. Residual learning (stage 4) must target Td.
stage2_physics_modules.note: single issue, physics only; not a validated forecast

stage4_residual_learning.caveat: the model is dominated by coastal ASOS rows with reanalysis inputs; mountain behaviour rests on ~1,500 AWS hours; station-level LOSO error is 1.40 degC (T) / 1.88 degC (Td) vs physics 1.41 / 2.26, time split 1.28 / 1.86 vs 1.47 / 2.43

gate_search.conclusion: the parcel value must not replace the lapse value whenever condensation is possible (+5 degC bias over all cross-wind hours); coastal lee warming is rare, daytime and clear-sky, so a 30 % blend during 11-16 KST is applied (physics_modules.FOEHN_BLEND / FOEHN_HOURS) and the index stays a diagnostic
